title: Signature graphic / build and removal
slide_intent: Give a graphic a readable entrance and exit so the viewer can recognize its shape before it disappears.
strategic_value: A striped heart built from DB red can connect an expressive motif to the wider identity.
demonstration: A red rectangular form resolves into a striped heart on a dark field and later collapses.
practical_value: Use staged construction when a signature graphic must become recognizable within a short sequence.

content_islands.name: Construction
content_islands.spec: Build the red striped heart from the initial rectangular form.

content_islands.name: Departure
content_islands.spec: Collapse the recognizable heart back toward an empty dark field.

reference_purposes.Expression: A red rectangular form resolves into a striped heart on a dark field and later collapses.
reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a playable demonstration of this repeatable sequence: A red rectangular form resolves into a striped heart on a dark field and later collapses.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Icons, Signature Graphics, or Animation im UI prose explains that animation directs focus, makes relationships understandable, and adds expression.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying guidance says animation is deliberate and never disturbing or complex.
